e33chat.screen.title: Chat
e33chat.description: Rebuilds the vanilla chat HUD in chat-app style
e33chat.config.title: E33Chat Settings
e33chat.config.discard.title: Discard Changes
e33chat.config.theme.desc: Switch the chat panel color theme (Dark / Light)
e33chat.config.enabled.desc: Turn the custom chat overlay on or off
e33chat.config.red_dot.desc: Show a red dot on the chat icon for unread messages
e33chat.config.hide_chat_icon.desc: Hide the on-screen chat icon (and its red dot)
e33chat.config.animation.desc: Play an animation when opening or closing the chat screen
e33chat.config.blur_enabled.desc: Blur the area behind the chat panel so text stands out
e33chat.config.panel_opacity.desc: Adjust the chat panel background opacity (0–100)
e33chat.config.debug_log.desc: Write message-handling details to latest.log (for troubleshooting)
e33chat.config.own_mention_notify.desc: Also show a sound and banner when you @ yourself (testing aid, off by default)
e33chat.config.own_quote_notify.desc: Also show a sound and banner when you quote yourself (testing aid, off by default)
e33chat.config.own_whisper_notify.desc: Also show a sound and banner when you whisper yourself via /msg (testing aid, off by default)
e33chat.config.own_bubble_color.desc: Set the background color of your own bubbles
e33chat.config.other_bubble_color.desc: Set the background color of other players' bubbles
e33chat.config.own_text_color.desc: Set the text color inside your own bubbles
e33chat.config.other_text_color.desc: Set the text color inside other players' bubbles
e33chat.config.bubble_corner_radius.desc: Adjust the bubble corner radius (0–10, 0 = square)
e33chat.config.strong_hint.desc: Pop system messages above the hotbar
e33chat.config.system_chat_as_bubble.des: Show system messages as chat bubbles instead of small gray text
e33chat.config.anti_spam.desc: Merge consecutive identical messages into one with a counter
e33chat.config.chat_history.desc: Save chat history per world and restore it on rejoin
e33chat.config.preserve_input.desc: Keep the text in the input box when closing the chat screen
e33chat.config.color_codes.desc: Color your own bubbles using & codes (safe, never kicks you)
e33chat.config.time_separator.desc: Insert a time label between messages after a gap (0 = off)
e33chat.config.sound_system.desc: Play a sound for system messages (join / leave / etc.)
e33chat.config.sound_whisper.desc: Play a sound for whisper messages
e33chat.config.sound_public.desc: Play a sound for public chat messages
e33chat.config.sound_volume.desc: Adjust the master volume of all notification sounds (0–100)
e33chat.config.sidebar_hide_patterns.des: Hide players matching these wildcards from the sidebar list (comma-separated, * = wildcard)
e33chat.config.mention_banner_enabled.de: Pop a notification banner at the top when @mentioned
e33chat.config.mention_banner_duration.d: Set how long the notification banner stays (2–10 seconds)
e33chat.config.mention_sound_enabled.des: Play a chime when @mentioned or quoted
e33chat.config.mention_whisper_banner.de: Also pop a banner for incoming whisper messages
e33chat.config.mention_require_at.desc: Only trigger a mention when the name has a leading @ (off = bare names count too)
e33chat.config.banner_corner_radius.desc: Adjust the notification banner corner radius (0–10, 0 = square)
e33chat.config.history_retention.desc: Delete history files older than this many days when joining a world (0 = keep forever)
